concerns.text: Phase 11 adds linting (ruff/black) and a lint report task (T037) but no functional requirement or success criterion in the spec references linting; this is an over‑reach beyond the documented FR/SC set.

Phase 12 creates unit tests for `config.py` and `utils/memory.py` (T039) without any FR or SC that mandates such tests; the spec only requires overall test coverage (≥ 80 %) which is already covered by the generic testing task.
Phase 13 runs an automated quickstart validation script (T041) yet the specification does not include a functional requirement for a validated quickstart; this task is not traceable to any FR/SC.

Phase 14 amends `spec.md` to state that `OLS_DEGRADED` governs memory constraints (T042). The spec already defines this governing rule in FR‑005/SC‑005; updating the spec is not a required deliverable and is not linked to any FR/SC.
Phase 15 adds GitHub Actions snippets for CI linting and testing, but the spec does not contain a requirement for CI integration; this element is not anchored to any FR or SC.
